'''Ysadria Kaladris''' was a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]], and among the most trusted of [[Grand Lord]] [[Darish Vol]]'s advisors in the [[Circle of Lords]]. It was Kaladris who debriefed the members of the Lost Tribe that returned to [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]] alongside [[Gavar Khai]]. It was also Kaladris that Lord Vol ordered to further monitor Khai for any signs of treachery.
